final_message:
This bug is already fixed in the checkout you gave me (6f37b07, v9.15.0), so the rule needs no change. My patch only adds regression tests.

**What I checked**
- **Published eslint 9.12.0:** I installed it and ran the snippet from the report. The bug shows up: the fix turns `else { if (false) {} }` into `else if (false) {}`, and the outer `else throw ...` then attaches to the wrong `if`.
- **This checkout:** the same snippet gets no `no-lonely-if` report and no fix. The rule now skips reporting when `astUtils.areBracesNecessary(parent, sourceCode)` is true. That check finds an inner `if` with no `else` of its own when an `else` follows the block. This revision's history has a commit with that change, 9db5b15 "fix: unsafe report for `no-lonely-if` (#19087)". I didn't look into it further because you asked me not to look at how this was resolved.
- **Existing tests:** one test already covers this case: `"if (a) if (a) {} else { if (b) {} } else {}"`.

To answer the reporter's question: it doesn't add braces to the outer `if`. In the unsafe case it now just doesn't report, which matches how `curly` handles it.

**What the patch adds**
In `tests/lib/rules/no-lonely-if.js`:
- **Unsafe cases that must not be reported:** the exact snippet from the report, an `if ... else if` chain with no final `else`, and an inner `if` with no `else` inside a `for` loop.
- **Safe cases that are still reported and fixed:** the inner chain ends in its own `else`, so the outer `else` can't attach to it.

All 22 tests pass and lint is clean. I first wrote my own version of this check in the rule. Its new tests failed because the rule already never reports those cases, so I reverted it.

You can drop the patch if you don't want the extra tests.
patch:
diff --git a/tests/lib/rules/no-lonely-if.js b/tests/lib/rules/no-lonely-if.js
index 54b3932..8d248a4 100644
--- a/tests/lib/rules/no-lonely-if.js
+++ b/tests/lib/rules/no-lonely-if.js
@@ -24,7 +24,12 @@ ruleTester.run("no-lonely-if", rule, {
     valid: [
         "if (a) {;} else if (b) {;}",
         "if (a) {;} else { if (b) {;} ; }",
-        "if (a) if (a) {} else { if (b) {} } else {}"
+        "if (a) if (a) {} else { if (b) {} } else {}",
+
+        // https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/19033
+        "if (a)\n\tif (b) {}\n\telse { if (c) {} }\nelse throw Error('unreachable');",
+        "if (a) if (b) {} else { if (c) {} else if (d) {} } else e();",
+        "if (a) if (b) {} else { if (c) for (;;) if (d) {} } else e();"
     ],
 
     // Examples of code that should trigger the rule
@@ -205,6 +210,16 @@ ruleTester.run("no-lonely-if", rule, {
             "    qux();\n" +
             "  }",
             errors
+        },
+        {
+            code: "if (a) if (b) {} else { if (c) {} else {} } else d();",
+            output: "if (a) if (b) {} else if (c) {} else {} else d();",
+            errors
+        },
+        {
+            code: "if (a) if (b) {} else { if (c) {} else if (d) {} else {} } else e();",
+            output: "if (a) if (b) {} else if (c) {} else if (d) {} else {} else e();",
+            errors
         }
     ]
 });
